method_references.limit: international implementation guidance; local procurement and validation remain required

states.meaning: Ordinary public mobility works without AI, account, network or model.
AI may aggregate grouped demand and explain a conflict without taking public right-of-way or human authority.
An outage, weather event or safety conflict freezes the digital layer and returns people to human or public transport service.
After withdrawal, the useful public asset remains independently maintainable and the change is archived.

prototypes.ordinary_service: rail_or_bus_arrival, walking and staffed loading guidance
prototypes.ai_boost: aggregate enterprise arrival windows and flag curb conflicts
prototypes.blackout_action: freeze shuttle or curb booking and dispatch public transport or a named marshal
prototypes.bequest_asset: paper curb-window register, protected-route sign and maintenance card
prototypes.responsible_role: enterprise mobility role plus transport/accessibility reviewer

prototypes.ordinary_service: walk-in, telephone, paper and continuous accessible route for daily needs
prototypes.ai_boost: group service windows and explain an optional detour without retaining continuous traces
prototypes.blackout_action: disable recommendation and keep the staffed route, public transport and complaint desk open
prototypes.bequest_asset: tactile/static route card, human service directory and dated correction log
prototypes.responsible_role: community liaison plus accessibility and privacy reviewer

prototypes.ordinary_service: rail timetable, public crossing, staffed wayfinding and a protected return path
prototypes.ai_boost: compare grouped transfer windows and propose reversible feeder separation
prototypes.blackout_action: remove feeder demand and preserve the public route when headway, crossing or curb evidence is missing
prototypes.bequest_asset: static interchange map, event-day curb protocol and public withdrawal notice
prototypes.responsible_role: rail/bus operations role plus independent safety reviewer

curb_observation_windows.formula: 3 key areas x 2 dayparts x 2 day types x 4 baseline weeks
curb_observation_windows.method: manual count of regulation, use, dwell, clearing, conflict and protected-route obstruction in a declared observation window

ordinary_route_attempts.formula: 3 key areas x 4 journey tasks x 2 dayparts

accessibility_walkthroughs.formula: 3 key areas x 2 dayparts x 2 affected-user perspectives

measurement_plan.sampling_limit: The counts are minimum coverage quantities, not a representative sample or a claim of recruitment, staffing, authorization or field completion.

phase_sequence.action: freeze ordinary journeys, site and rights boundaries, responsible role slots, prohibited data and manual count forms
phase_sequence.gate: authorized planning scope, named stop owner and dated evidence boundary

phase_sequence.action: collect the planned manual curb windows, ordinary route attempts and accessibility walkthroughs before any AI comparison
phase_sequence.gate: each critical journey has a usable non-AI route and no unresolved critical access blocker

phase_sequence.action: run read-only shadow comparisons with synthetic or separately authorized grouped data
phase_sequence.gate: AI remains optional, reversible and unable to reduce basic service

phase_sequence.action: rehearse blackout, weather, blocked-route and missing-receiver handoffs with public notice and reservation freeze
phase_sequence.gate: every critical failure stops safely and records a dated receiver, fallback and restoration action

phase_sequence.action: independently review coverage, group differences, maintenance burden, complaints and bequest assets
phase_sequence.gate: one written hold, repair, bounded-pilot or retire decision discloses conflicts and unresolved issues

gate_thresholds.measure: declared critical journeys with a usable public, staffed, telephone or paper route
unresolved critical accessibility blockers on declared routes
observed minutes in which fire, emergency or accessible routes are displaced
cases where refusing AI reduces basic mobility access
records due for deletion with verified deletion evidence
independent decision packet with conflicts and dissent disclosed

accountability_slots.duty: declare routes, timetables, capacity evidence and public-transport fallback
approve affected-user participation and critical-blocker closure
own curb regulations, clearing, emergency protection and maintenance
approve purpose, fields, access, retention, deletion and validation
own notice, complaint, appeal, correction and non-participation
review conflicts and sign hold, repair, bounded-pilot or retire

data_boundary.independent_validation: technology output must be compared with separately collected manual ground truth before use in a decision
data_boundary.repository_rule: no real participant, vehicle or case-level field record enters the public repository

boundary: The contract makes ordinary service, manual baseline measurement, bounded AI, withdrawal and retained public assets reviewable. It does not prove a route, staffing, capacity, authorization, user outcome, safety result, operating performance or official score.
